documents.title: Autumn League 2026 sailing instructions
documents.why: 6.1 and 6.2 A and B place the offshore and inshore starting areas and define their starting lines, which the cards do not; 6.1 C and 6.2 C say the windward mark Z is laid to windward of the line and is the first mark of every fixed-mark course, and that the course card forms part of these instructions.

documents.title: Autumn League 2026, sailing instructions amendment 01
documents.why: Replaces 6.2 D, the inshore finishing line, adding the instruction to pass Spit to starboard on the way to it that the inshore card already printed. It leaves 6.2 A and B, which the start line is read from, as they were.

artifacts.why: The club has not published a 2026 technical sheet, though SI 6.1 C and 6.2 C name one; the 2025 sheet is the current list of the marks these cards letter, and the drafts these cards were published from were laid out on its positions — see the README.
